analysis: Both changed files are live, env-gated tests (DARKBLOOM_LIVE_MLX_TESTS=1 plus a model gate). The only diffs add a `.logprobs` case to exhaustive switches over server stream events: GemmaToolCallLiveTests.swift line 264 (`case .info, .logprobs: break`) and Qwen36ProductionCanaryTests.swift lines 394-395 (`case .logprobs: break`). The change makes the tests compile against a new stream-event enum case and ignores logprob data in the tests. No production source is touched. There are no changes to the coordinator/provider WebSocket contract, E2E encryption, attestation, App Attest authorization, prefix-cache SSD storage (T-041), key handling or fan helper. The tests only read local model paths and env-var overrides, as before, and add no network surface or secrets. Unchanged production code, which this PR must introduce elsewhere to add `.logprobs`, is outside these units. A separate pass should check whether logprobs emission can leak data or add a side channel. That concerns prompt/completion confidentiality (A-001) and the coordinator-to-provider response encryption path (T-008), and it cannot be assessed from these test-only units. No regression is identified here.
